## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change, and fail without it.
- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck` and the tests of the changed packages pass.
- [ ] The README of the package is updated, if the behavior or the API changes.
- [ ] A changeset describes the change for users (`pnpm changeset`), or none is needed (tests, CI, internal changes).
- [ ] Breaking changes are marked `major` in the changeset, with what users must do.
